scope: Synthetic component screening only; no measured whole-model gain or bound

cpu_proof.scope: Host IEEE arithmetic model only; actual GPU parity separately required

signed_zero_observation.interpretation: Exact parity with baseline, not signed-zero preservation

exhaustive_gpu_audit.safe_extraction: Hash checked before extraction; only regular files/directories, approved topdirs, no absolute/traversal/link members. Fresh directory.
exhaustive_gpu_audit.limits: Scalar all-encoding and prescribed mixed-tail/offset equivalence to exact baseline at scales4096/512 only. No full model integration or speed claim.

analysis.estimator: Median of three within-ABBA paired mean differences per descriptor; maximum callcounts; negatives clipped only for optimistic sums; no cross-scenario mixing
analysis.scope: Synthetic single-kernel screening estimate, not whole-model gain or bound
analysis.cache_caveat: Warm or scrub-conditioned; scrub-conditioned is not guaranteed cold
analysis.timing_caveat: Single-launch HIP event brackets can include host submission gaps

independent_audit.limits: Synthetic single-launch event screen at maximum supplied callcounts; no whole-model gain or bound. Scrub-conditioned is not guaranteed cold; event durations may include submission gaps. Three ABBA quartets per cell.

publication: Sanitized report, numeric samples, metrics and index only; no private paths, raw logs, model or capture payloads, credentials or binaries.
